dedupe_keys.name: production d une toiture photovoltaique par tranches de 10mn

description: Production d'une toiture photovoltaïque par tranches de 10mn is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gildas Lemaitre. kWh produced in 10-minute increments by a 3kWp solar roof. These data are accompanied by a graphical representation specially developed to see at a glance the variations in the day throughout the year, over several years. The data, updated at the end of each quarter, are available on: downloadable in.xls format with graphical representations in.pdf. Coverage: Gildas Lemaitre. The portal shows the English title as "Production of a photovoltaic roof in 10-minute increments" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gildas Lemaitre. Its keywords include ensoleillement, ern, energie-renouvelable, photovoltaique. The listing shows 2014-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
